model_output:
```sql
WITH stadium_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM pois
  WHERE poi_name ILIKE 'Pioneer Stadium'
    AND addr_city ILIKE 'Ogden'
    AND addr_state ILIKE 'UT'
),
high_elevation_areas AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(rast) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM stadium_geom))
),
clipped_high_elevation AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(
             rast,
             (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM stadium_geom),
             true
           ) AS rast
  FROM high_elevation_areas
),
buffered_stadium AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(geometry, 3100) AS buffered_geom
  FROM stadium_geom
),
high_elevation_buffered AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(rast) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT buffered_geom FROM buffered_stadium))
),
clipped_high_elevation_buffered AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(
             rast,
             (SELECT buffered_geom FROM buffered_stadium),
             true
           ) AS rast
  FROM high_elevation_buffered
),
elevation_condition AS (
  SELECT rast
  FROM clipped_high_elevation_buffered
  WHERE ST_MinimumValue(rast) >= 1100
)
SELECT (SELECT poi_name FROM pois WHERE geometry = (SELECT geometry FROM stadium_geom)) AS stadium_name;
```
